posts.headline: Sasinci can't buy a point total — 101.6 last week, 0-1 through the whole sample, and Big Head's title banner is now a punchline on a 13-15 career record.
posts.detail: Four straight editions warning about the reckoning and here it is: Sasinci's average finish sits at 5.5 with zero signs of life, and 'Megamind' hasn't found the scoreboard yet.

posts.headline: Twenty-one editions of nothing from One Nut Barner while Put it in Ra's league-best 1.5 average finish takes on water at 0-1.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record is supposed to mean something, but 123.66 points and a loss says the Cal Berkeley grad's roster is failing the eye test — silence won't fix a fraud narrative if it keeps compounding.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh is still unbeaten, but 120.4 points is still bottom-three in the league — the untalented tenth is winning on fumes, not football.
posts.detail: A 4-10, dead-last résumé doesn't earn benefit of the doubt after one week, and this Chauncey mirage is due to evaporate the second the schedule gets real.

posts.headline: Thicks is 1-0 again but 138.94 points is still the softest winning score a supposed title-pedigree team has posted all season.
posts.detail: A 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish is not the résumé of a team that should be sneaking by — all that ring equity means nothing if Klint's Clipboard keeps winning by accident instead of authority.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is still buried at a league-worst 72.02 points and the Ultimate Light Skin's judgment day has officially become a running plague.
posts.detail: A 13-14-1 career mark was already shaky, and starting 0-1 with the lowest score in Busters Anonymous is straight fire-and-brimstone for a guy who once drafted a defender first overall.
